description: Galigeo for Microsoft Power BI enables organizations to visualize, analyze and operate location-based data to gain new insights, make informed decisions and improve their business processes. Designed for data analysts, business intelligence professionals, GIS experts and business teams, it offers a wide set of both technical and business features to harness the location dimension contained in any data into actionable insights. Geodata Visualization By leveraging drag-n-drop interface, Galigeo lets you plot any of your KPIs on the map. Points, polygons, lines, all sort of geometries can be displayed. Multiple layers are supported, without any number limitation. You can create the following type of representations (non-exhaustive list): Choropleth Color Ranges Proportional Symbols Qualitative Values Heatmap Cluster Flows H3 and Hexagons Customizable labels Customizable tooltips ... It supports all native map functionalities, like scroll, zoom in and out, pan, pinch, drill-down and drill-through. Spatial Analysis Galigeo gives you access to advanced spatial analysis in a self-service fashion, to spatially select and filter data on the map: Crow-fly distance (also called Isodistance), in metric or imperial Drive-time (by car, foot, truck, bike) Free-drawing Animated Time Series ...
